jobs.title: Human Capital - Product Operations Associate
jobs.location: New York, NY (office arrangement not specified)
jobs.salary: $110,000–$130,000 annual base; first-year guaranteed year-end bonus
jobs.why: Exceptional early-career-friendly product/business operations role (not a formal apprenticeship). Supports HR technology platforms through system configuration, user-access permissions, troubleshooting, requirements, testing, feature rollout and data audits. jobs.title: Business Analyst (CEO Strategy & Operations)
jobs.location: New York, NY — hybrid label, 4–5 days/week on-site required
jobs.why: Operations/strategy analyst role in local media and adtech, an industry Audrey knows from Orion reporting operations. Requires 2–4 years in an execution-heavy analytical role; work includes cross-functional project coordination, performance analysis, operational gap identification, reporting and stakeholder alignment.
jobs.gap: This is not a traditional requirements/UAT BA role. CEO-sponsored initiatives, board/investor decks and advanced Google Slides executive storytelling are not established in Audrey's profile. Four to five on-site days per week is substantially more than her preferred hybrid cadence. Only the upper range reaches $100K.
